prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a parking lot collision. The patient had 26 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1430; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and was diagnosed with concussion. Over the course of care, the patient attended 26 visits. Presenting symptoms included headache, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating, and the reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the crash described. Neurological examination showed some findings that support the diagnosis, while other testing returned within normal limits. No prior injury to the head or neck region is known. Treatment followed a typical progression of symptom monitoring, vestibular and cognitive rest guidance, and graded return to activity. Visit frequency decreased steadily as symptoms resolved and the patient improved. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated or repeated entries.
